title: docs.sentry.io/pricing
snippet:
Sentry offers a 14 day free trial with unlimited event data on the Business plan. You can upgrade or return to the features and quotas included with your existing plan. Without a paid plan, you will be automatically assigned a free Developer plan at the end of your trial.
Every paid plan includes a [preset volume](https://docs.sentry.io/pricing.md#pricing-how-it-works) of event data, with a PAYG bugdet that you control. The free Developer plan has similar presets. See Sentry's [plan page](https://sentry.io/pricing/) for more details.

## [Plans and Free Trials](https://docs.sentry.io/pricing.md#plans-and-free-trials)
Sentry has one free Developer plan and three paid plans: Team, Business, and Enterprise. You can find more information about each by going to our [pricing page](https://sentry.io/pricing/).
Plan upgrades take effect immediately. Plan downgrades and cancellations are processed at the end of the current contract cycle and cannot be refunded. If you no longer want to be on a paid plan, you'll revert to the base Developer plan at the end of your current contract.
All new Sentry accounts come with a 14-day free trial period. You'll have the option to upgrade and continue to use Sentry's paid features at any time before your trial ends. Upgrades will be effective immediately. Users who haven't upgraded by the end of their free trial will return to the features and quotas included with their existing plan.

## Is Sentry free? The Developer plan
Yes, for one person. The Developer plan costs $0 with no time limit. It includes error monitoring and tracing, email alerts, release health, 10 custom dashboards and MCP access, with **5,000 errors**, 5 million spans and 50 replays a month and a 30-day lookback. New accounts start on a **14-day Business trial** without a credit card and drop to Developer when it ends unless they upgrade. Each product, such as replays, can also be trialled once for 14 days with unlimited volume.
### Free plan limits
- **One user.** A second developer needs Team.
- No pay-as-you-go budget. Sentry offers the budget on paid plans only, so error number 5,001 in a month is dropped until the cycle resets.
- No API or third-party integrations, so alerts go by email instead of Slack.
- No profiling, which needs a pay-as-you-go budget.

title: Free, Team $26, Business $80 + a Real Bill
snippet:
**Sentry is free for one developer, then $26 a month on Team or $80 on Business, billed annually.** Those base prices include 50,000 errors, 5 million spans and 50 session replays a month; everything above that is pay-as-you-go. A 3-developer app with 120,000 errors a month pays about **$67 a month on Team** and **$177 on Business**, and adding Sentry's Seer AI debugger at $40 per contributor takes the Team bill to **$187**.

| Plan | Price | Users | Included each month | Data kept |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | $0 | 1 | 5,000 errors, 5M spans, 50 replays, 5 GB logs | 30 days |
| Team | $26/mo billed annually | Unlimited | 50,000 errors, 5M spans, 50 replays, 5 GB logs, 5 GB metrics, 1 cron + 1 uptime monitor | Up to 90 days |
| Business | $80/mo billed annually | Unlimited | Same quotas as Team, plus unlimited dashboards, SAML + SCIM, 1,000 metric monitors | Up to 90 days, plus sampled retention |
| Enterprise | Custom | Unlimited | Custom quotas, technical account manager | Custom |

### Is Sentry free?
Yes, for one person. The Developer plan is $0 with 5,000 errors a month, error monitoring and tracing, email alerts, 10 dashboards and 30 days of data. The second developer on the account needs Team, which allows unlimited users.

title: Sentry pricing in 2026: plans, quotas, Seer and what a team pays
snippet:
- Sentry has a free Developer plan for one user. Team costs $26 a month and Business $80, billed annually, with unlimited users.

Sentry pricing starts at $0 for one developer. Team costs $26 a month and Business $80 a month when billed annually, both with unlimited users, and Enterprise is priced by Sentry’s sales team ([Sentry pricing](https://sentry.io/pricing/), checked October 3, 2026). Each plan includes a monthly quota of errors, spans, replays and logs. Usage beyond the quota is billed as reserved volume or pay-as-you-go, and Seer, Sentry’s AI debugger, is a separate subscription at $40 per active contributor a month.

| Plan | Per month, billed annually | Billed monthly | What the plan adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | $0 | $0 | One user, email alerts, 10 custom dashboards, MCP access, 30-day lookback |
| Team | $26 | $29 | Unlimited users, API and third-party integrations, 20 dashboards, up to 90-day lookback |
| Business | $80 | $89 | Unlimited dashboards, advanced quota management, SAML and SCIM, extra sampled retention |
| Enterprise | Quoted by sales | Quoted by sales | A technical account manager and dedicated support |

| Included each month | Developer | Team | Business |
|---|---|---|---|
| Errors | 5k | 50k | 50k |
| Spans (tracing) | 5M | 5M | 5M |
| Session replays | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Logs and application metrics | 5GB each | 5GB each | 5GB each |
| Attachments | 1GB | 1GB | 1GB |
| Uptime and cron monitors | 1 each | 1 each | 1 each |
| Metric monitors | 20 | 20 | 1,000 |

## Free trials and discounts
- **Business trial:** new accounts get a 14-day Business trial and return to the free Developer plan afterwards. Each product can also be tried once for 14 days with unlimited events, and Seer has its own trial.
- **Startups:** Sentry’s [startup program](https://sentry.io/for/startups/) offers up to $5,000 in credits that expire one year after joining. The page names no eligibility rules.
- **Nonprofits and open source:** registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits and open-source projects with a permissive license such as MIT or Apache can get a sponsored account with large monthly quotas, including 5M errors and 100K replays.
- **Education:** students get a free year through the GitHub Student Developer Pack.

As of October 2026, Sentry's Developer plan is free for one user, Team costs $26 a month and Business $80 a month when billed annually, and Enterprise is priced by Sentry's sales team.
